title: Rapid Urban Expansion Detected
recommendation: Rapid urbanization is occurring in the study area. Engage HMDA (Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority) to review Master Plan compliance. Prioritize green buffer zones and ensure infrastructure (roads, water, drainage) is upgraded proportionally.
why: Urban cover increased by 0.5% (0.02 km²) between 2023-01-15 and 2023-06-15, exceeding the rapid-expansion threshold of 10%.
